desc:
JOIN THE NEW DISCORD BELOW!

🎻 Join a real orchestra and play classical music with friends in a grand concert hall!

🎵 PICK YOUR INSTRUMENT
Violin, cello, trumpet, flute, harp, timpani and more: 16 instruments. Keep your seat song after song.

✨ PLAY YOUR SOLO
The spotlight can land on YOU. The orchestra stops, the camera swoops in, and the crowd decides: cheers and roses… or boos and tomatoes! 🍅

🗳️ VOTE FOR THE NEXT SONG
Ode to Joy, Can-Can, Canon in D, Swan Lake, In the Hall of the Mountain King, Flight of the Bumblebee and more.

🎟️ WATCH FROM THE AUDIENCE
Grab a theatre seat, cheer your friends on and throw roses at the best soloist.

⭐ REQUEST A CONCERTO
Walk into the spotlight at center stage and play 5 solos while the whole hall watches.

🪙 Earn coins to unlock solo entrances: confetti, fireworks, lightning and more!
